dedupe_keys.name: paddlespatial wind power forecasting gru baseline

description: PaddlePaddle developers provide a gated recurrent unit baseline for spatial wind-power forecasting within PaddleSpatial. The example includes training and evaluation scripts, configuration options and a compact recurrent model followed by dropout and a linear output layer. Its README documents Python and operating-system requirements and the checkpoint workflow. Source access is public and free under Apache 2.0. The example targets the SDWPF turbine observations and can be adapted to compatible time-series forecasting tasks. Forecast outputs can inform dispatch and generation scenarios in electricity simulations such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that this repository entry is source code, not a verified pretrained forecasting service. Data preparation, horizon settings and train/test separation must be checked before comparison with published results. No dependency installation, training or evaluation was performed.
